title: cocculus mollis
intro: Cocculus mollis, commonly known as Chinese Argyreia or Chinese climbing spinach, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia and China, belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and relieve pain. The therapeutic actions of Cocculus mollis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties, which make it effective in treating anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Cocculus mollis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
